summary.text: Angela McIntosh is the Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 3, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: McIntosh was the Republican nominee for Maryland State Senate District 3 in 2022, after advancing from the July 19, 2022 Republican primary.
She received 33.4% of the vote in the November 8, 2022 general election, which Democrat Karen Lewis Young won with 66.5%.
